exposure: Category II fetal heart rates (FHRs) with significant decels (SigDecels)
standardized intervention process for Category II fetal heart rates (FHRs) with significant decels (SigDecels)
cohort: Patients with Category II fetal heart rates from six hospitals
finding: Standardized management of recurrent significant decelerations reduced the rate of 5-minute APGAR scores of < 7 and severe unexpected newborn complications.
mod_finding: The rate of primary cesarean delivery decreased, while there were nonsignificant increases in vaginal and operative vaginal births.
